name: The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo
accessSummary: Roppongi Station (Hibiya Line, Oedo Line): directly connected / Nogizaka Station (Chiyoda Line)
hours: Meeting packages: up to 8 hours between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM (half day or full day)

rooms.name: 2F The Ritz-Carlton Grand Ballroom (all of Ballroom I to IV)
rooms.note: On the official floor plan, the grand ballroom is divided into 4 rooms, Ballroom I to IV. The total area stated on the official page varies: 1,352㎡ in the opening figures, 1,100㎡ in the description, and about 990㎡ (6 rooms in total) in the heading. The number of rooms also differs: the opening figures say 9 event rooms and 11 small meeting rooms, the heading says 6 rooms in total, and the FAQ says 9 rooms.

rooms.name: 2F The Foyer (pre-function area adjacent to the Grand Ballroom)
1F The Parkview Room (entire room)
rooms.note: The area in the description is 220㎡. It can be divided into Parkview West and Parkview East.

rooms.name: 1F Magnolia Garden Room (The Garden Room + The Magnolia Room)
rooms.note: Conference style: 30 people. The description says it can be divided into the Garden Room of 50㎡ and the Magnolia Room of 35㎡ (the table gives the Garden Room as 56㎡).

ops.parking: There is a parking lot on the hotel grounds; the rates are 800 yen per hour, 8,000 yen per day and 56,000 yen per week. A valet parking service (8,000 yen per day) and electric vehicle charging stations are also available. (Official facility information)
ops.restaurants: The official dining page lists 7 venues in the hotel: Nina at The Ritz-Carlton, Tokyo (patisserie, daily 11:00-20:00), Héritage by Kei Kobayashi (French cuisine, closed Tue and Wed), Bistronomie "Towers" (daily 7:00-10:30 / 11:30-15:00 / 17:30-21:00), Hinokizaka (Japanese cuisine: kaiseki, sushi, tempura and teppanyaki; daily 11:30-14:30 / 17:30-21:00), The Lobby Lounge (daily from 11:00, until 23:00 on Fri and Sat), The Bar (45th floor, from 15:00; from 12:00 on Sat and Sun), La Boutique (daily 11:00-21:00).
